subject: Security discovery follow-up: VPC/private deployment options (SOC 2 / SSQ)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Rodgers <samantha@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery follow-up: VPC/private deployment options (SOC 2 / SSQ)

Hi Samantha

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap
- Primary ask: private/VPC deployment for FinHealth production workloads with strong network isolation and auditability.
- Compliance: SOC 2 type II in progress (expected Q4), GDPR applicable, HIPAA considerations for PHI.
- Procurement: procurement@finhealth.com will own contract/PO.

Next steps
1) We'll kick off our vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) and share our answers + SOC 2 roadmap.
2) I'm attaching a high-level private deployment diagram (private-deployment-diagram.png) and our SSQ template to start. Marissa will provide technical details.
3) Can you confirm the procurement contact (copied) and any internal deadline for security review?
4) If air-gapped/on-prem is a hard requirement, please flag now so we can scope options and timelines.

Attachments: private-deployment-diagram.png, redwood_ssq_v1.pdf

Happy to set a follow-up with your security/infra team next week. Proposed times: Tue/Wed 10-12 PT.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.inference

From: Samantha Rodgers <samantha@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up: VPC/private deployment options (SOC 2 / SSQ)

Thanks Marcus appreciate the recap. A few notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: We need vendor SOC 2 Type II report. Our internal program is on a similar timeline (Q4), but for purchase approval we need evidence or compensating controls. Can you share your SOC 2 report or roadmap?
- SSQ: Please send the completed SSQ to security@finhealth.com. We'll also provide our standard procurement questionnaire.
- Air-gap/on-prem: This is a possible requirement for a subset of workloads. Can Redwood support an air-gapped deployment, or fully on-prem in an air-gapped environment? If so, what's the typical lead time and any additional compliance constraints?
- Architecture: We reviewed the high-level diagram you attached; procurement needs a slightly more detailed network diagram showing egress controls and KMS integration.

Procurement contact is procurement@finhealth.com (cc'd). Our security lead, Alan Cho, will be looped in once we have the SSQ and SOC evidence.

Thanks,
Samantha Rodgers
Head of Security Programs
FinHealth Inc.

Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up: VPC/private deployment options (SOC 2 / SSQ)

Hi Samantha

Thanks for the fast response. Looping in Marissa (Product PM, Dedicated/Private) and Neha (Security/Privacy) to provide the detailed diagram and SSQ answers. Marissa/Neha: please see Samantha's asks below and the attached initial artifacts.

Quick answers up-front:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II in production for hosted services; for Dedicated/Private deployments we provide a customer-specific SOC/risk alignment package and can share our controls mapping. We expect the public SOC 2 summary and evidence bundle to be available next month. I'll attach the SOC roadmap once finalized.
- Air-gapped/on-prem: We support on-prem air-gapped deployments as a premium offering (requires planning, dedicated engineering and onsite/network validation). Typical lead time: 10-14 weeks from signed SOW for a greenfield air-gapped install; shorter if we're deploying into a cloud VPC with strict egress controls.
- KMS/Key management: We support customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, Azure Key Vault) and have procedures for key rotation and audit logging.

Samantha, we will: 
1) Start completing the SSQ (redwood_ssq_v1.pdf) and aim to return a first pass within 3 business days.
2) Share an updated deployment diagram showing subnet isolation, NAT/eips, KMS flows, and audit log routing (attachment: private-deployment-diagram.png).
3) Propose a 30-minute technical deep-dive with your security/infra folks next Wed 10am PT. Does that work?

Marissa/Neha: see action items below to help complete SSQ and produce the detailed network diagram.

Hi all

Thanks for the context. I've reviewed Marcus' notes and attached a more detailed checklist we'll deliver alongside the SSQ. High-level items for FinHealth to confirm so we can finalize the diagram and timeline: 

- Workload scope: which services will be routed to the private deployment (inference-only vs. training / fine-tuning)?
- Connectivity: do you need a completely air-gapped environment or a VPC with strict egress controls and dedicated NATs?
- KMS preference: which cloud KMS or HSM will you use (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, Azure Key Vault, customer HSM)?
- Audit retention: how long do you need audit logs retained and where should we route them (S3 bucket, SIEM endpoint)?

Planned deliverables by end of week: 
- Completed SSQ first pass (redwood_ssq_v1.pdf)
- Updated deployment diagram with subnet & route details (private-deployment-diagram.png)
- SOC 2 controls mapping document (will share as soon as SOC roadmap is finalized)

Samantha: Wed 10am PT for the technical deep-dive works for us. I'll send a calendar invite to Alan and your infra team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference
